programs.title: American Monster
programs.desc: Rogelio Morales is a handsome Marine who sweeps Margarita Sanchez Lemus off her feet; their whirlwind romance leads to marriage and the birth of a beautiful son; behind Rogelio's winning smile lurks a monster who will soon show his true colors.

programs.title: Evil Lives Here
programs.desc: Victoria and Christine Lisowski live in fear of their mother, Sungnam Kwon-Lisowski; they never imagine that this Christmas, they'll feel lucky to survive the holiday and their mother's crazed vengeance.

programs.title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
programs.sub_title: One Child in Heaven, One in Jail
programs.desc: Not every mother and father raise the child of their dreams, as some children grow up to become killers; through heart-stopping stories, parents must come face to face with the horrible truth that the child they loved and trusted is a monster.

programs.title: Murder at Silver Peak
programs.desc: In a remote Nevada mining town, a truck driver vanishes and silence greets every question; as investigators search for answers, a wall of secrecy holds firm while troubling clues surface, hinting at fear, suspicion, and a hidden truth.

programs.desc: In 1981, two men rape and shoot a young mother and force her fiancé to watch; after nearly dying, the woman learns her attackers are a pair of serial killers, who are also brothers; it will take two decades before justice prevails over the men.
